inclusion_rules: Natural claim wording from reviewed public evidence packets
At least one material numerical or temporal construction question
Retained evidence text is legally accessible or already permitted
Exact offsets can be annotated without downloading restricted material
exclusion_rules: Private, paywalled, deleted, or access-controlled evidence without permission
Cases generated solely to match an implemented regular expression
Duplicate claims or shared-origin evidence beyond the family cap
Claims whose answer depends on undisclosed personal data
Any case previously exposed during held-out evaluation
sampling_order: Collect eligible case metadata without model assistance
Apply source, dimension, and construction-label quotas
Assign splits using the frozen seed and family-level grouping
Hash and freeze the dataset before any assisted-construction call
